h:
这是一个非常简单的 ComfyUI 初学者友好的 Flux.2 Klein 9B KV GGUF 简单完美的快速礼服照片拍摄工作流程，将使用非常简单的自然语言文本编辑指令来生成您想要的礼服照片拍摄四张参考图像 - 图 1 是面部参考，图片 2 是没有头部可见的礼服（也许还有鞋类参考），图 3 是照片拍摄的背景，最后图 4 是姿势参考。生成的输出将紧密（但不完全）匹配这 4 个输入中的元素。请参阅包含工作流的 zip 文件中包含的 Prompt_sets.txt 文件，了解有关如何在没有任何输入的情况下生成初始输入以及如何将它们组合到此工作流的单个输出中的一般指南。我还提供了包含 5 个图像（4 个输入 + 1 个输出）的示例数据集，以便您更好地了解 了解此工作流程。这不使用 LORA 或 ControlNet（Flux.2 Klein 官方尚未提供任何可行的解决方案，但它仍然可以做很多很酷的事情）。

我使用了 Q2 Flux.2 Klein 9B KV GGUF 模型，它与我的 8GB VRAM AMD GPU 甚至具有较低 6GB VRAM 的 GPU 配合良好。但是如果你有更好的 GPU，你可以简单地将模型替换为完全未量化的 Flux.2 Klein 9B KV 模型，或者在另一边，如果你有更弱的 4GB VRAM 甚至 2GB VRAM GPU，你可以从这里找到其他低级硬件支持的 GGUF 模型（ Unsloth 的 HuggingFace repo for Flux.2 Klein 4B GGUF 模型 -https://huggingface.co/unsloth/FLUX.2-klein-4B-GGUF/tree/main）和其他数学资源。由于此工作流程不使用任何 LORA，因此可以轻松修改以使用任何常规或 GGUF Flux.2 Klein 9B 或 4B 模型文件，但您可能会或不会获得更好的结果。

FLUX.2 klein 9B KV 是标准 9B 型号的优化变体，专为多参考图像编辑而设计。常规 9B 模型是高质量、通用生成的强大工具，而 KV（键值）版本是一种专门的工具，适用于在多个生成或编辑中使用相同参考图像的任务。

此工作流程还可以帮助您将 AI Photoshoot 输出生成数据保存到人类可读的 .txt 文件中。这将自动获取您的元数据并将其写入 .txt 文件。此外，通过使用 Image Saver Simple 节点，您可以将工作流程本身嵌入到每个保存的图像中，或者单独保存工作的图像和工作流程。通过这种方式，将为该工作流程的每次运行生成一个可读的 .txt 文件（与 Automatic1111 / EasyDiffusion 的 .txt 输出匹配）。

您需要一个 Hugging Face 帐户来下载所需的文件（详情如下）。确保使用 ComfyUI 管理器或您可能拥有的任何其他缺失节点安装 ComfyUI 的 GGUF 插件，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、MagicWAN Image v2、QWEN、HunyuanImage-2.1、HiDream、KREA、Kontext、Chroma、AuraFlow、Z-Image Turbo、Flux.1 Dev、Flux.2 Klein 4B 和 9B 的其他工作流程。随意在您喜欢的东西上扔一些黄色的嗡嗡声。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的 GGUF（或将其替换为完整模型）模型，然后

#2.现在选择您的图像 - 图片 1 为脸部，图片 2 为裙子，图片 3 为背景，图片 4 为姿势。

＃3。在下一步中输入您的图像编辑说明..（请参阅包含的 Prompt_sets.txt 文件以获取一般指南）

＃4。然后选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。之后选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置（您可能想保留默认值）

＃5。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

..最终的 Dress Photoshoot 输出将非常接近（但不完全）匹配这 4 个输入的元素。尝试非常精确地提示您以获得更好的结果，有时即使是微小的调整也可能给您带来出色或糟糕的结果。

o.en:
This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly Flux.2 Klein 9B KV GGUF Simple Flawless Fast Dress Photoshoot Workflow that will work with very simple text editing instructions in natural language to generate your desired Dress Photoshoot out four reference images - Picture 1 is a Face Reference, Picture 2 is the Dress ( & maybe Footwear Reference ) with no head visible, Picture 3 is the background of the photoshoot and lastly Picture 4 is the pose reference. The resulting output will closely (but not exactly) match elements from those 4 inputs. See the Prompt_sets.txt file included in the zip file containing the workflow for a general guideline on how to generate the initial inputs if you don't have any inputs and how to combine them in a single output for this workflow. I also included a sample dataset of five images (4 inputs + 1 output) with this for you to have better understanding of this workflow. This uses NO LORA or ControlNet ( officially Flux.2 Klein have not yet provided any viable solution for it but still it can do lots of cool stuffs ).

I used a Q2 Flux.2 Klein 9B KV GGUF Model that works well with my 8GB VRAM AMD GPU or even GPUs with lower 6GB VRAM. But is you have better GPU you can simply swap the model with full unquantized Flux.2 Klein 9B KV model or on the other side if you have a much weaker 4GB VRAM or even 2GB VRAM GPU you can find other low grade hardware supported GGUF models from here ( Unsloth's HuggingFace repo for Flux.2 Klein 4B GGUF models -https://huggingface.co/unsloth/FLUX.2-klein-4B-GGUF/tree/main) and other mathing resources. As this workflow does not use any LORA it can be easily modified to work with any regular or GGUF Flux.2 Klein 9B or 4B model file but you may or not get better results.

The FLUX.2 klein 9B KV is an optimized variant of the standard 9B model specifically designed for multi-reference image editing. While the regular 9B model is a powerhouse for high-quality, general-purpose generation, the KV (Key-Value) version is a specialized tool for tasks where you are using the same reference images across multiple generations or edits.

This workflow also helps you to save your AI Photoshoot output generation Data into a human readable .txt file. This will automatically get and write your metadata to the .txt file. Also with the Image Saver Simple node used you may embed the workflow itself with each saved image or save the image and workflow for your work separately. In this way a readable .txt file for each run of this workflow will be generated (matching Automatic1111 / EasyDiffusion's .txt outputs).

You need a Hugging Face account to download your necessary files (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you install GGUF addon for ComfyUI using ComfyUI manager or any other missing nodes you may have and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, MagicWAN Image v2, QWEN, HunyuanImage-2.1, HiDream, KREA, Kontext, Chroma, AuraFlow, Z-Image Turbo, Flux.1 Dev, Flux.2 Klein 4B and 9B. Feel free to toss some yellow Buzz on stuffs you like.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired GGUF (or swap it with full model) model first and

#2. now select your images - Picture 1 for Face, Picture 2 for Dress, Picture 3 for Background and Picture 4 for Pose.

#3. on next step enter your image editing instructions.. (see the Prompt_sets.txt file included for a general guideline)

#4. then select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. after this select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings (you may wanna stay with defaults)

#5. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

..The resulting Dress Photoshoot output will very closely (but not exactly) match elements from those 4 inputs. Try to be very precise with your prompt for better results, sometimes even a minor tweak can get you excellent or bad results.
